V1.scale: measured allocation grows linearly at ~42.5 KB per unique line (total allocation including temporaries); retained cache per entry is ~4 KB (HTML string with CSS + key/node overhead). With 1 GB heap and ~200 MB JVM/context baseline, ~800 MB available for cache entries; OOM at ~200K unique lines. At 4 bytes per line (3-byte unique content + 1-byte newline), about 800 KB of input
